title: orchis incarnata subsp. lanceata
intro: Orchis incarnata subsp. lanceata, commonly known as the Red Helleborine, is a type of orchid that belongs to the family Orchidaceae. It is known for its potential health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that may help to reduce stress and improve overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to act as a sedative, reducing anxiety and promoting relaxation, and its potential to act as an anti-histamine, reducing allergic reactions. The bioactive constituents of Orchis incarnata subsp. lanceata include alkaloids and flavonoids, which are believed to contribute to its therapeutic properties.
